display.purpose: Daily progress and remaining-time readouts only.

body.purpose: Original text, notes and imported passages.

label.purpose: Segment numbers, timestamps and small instrument labels.

shadows.name: paper
shadows.purpose: Temporary elevation for the mini-player, dialog and toast.

motion.name: hold-fill
motion.purpose: The one authored interaction: pressing the hold key to enter recitation.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Confirming an import, save or other non-destructive primary action.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 36px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--c-radius, 2px); background: var(--c-fg); color: var(--c-panel); font: 400 14px/1 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'PingFang SC', sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--c-fg-soft); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgb(var(--c-lit) / 0.72); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary and cancel actions that should stay close to the instrument surface.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 36px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--c-hairline); border-radius: var(--c-radius, 2px); background: var(--c-panel); color: var(--c-fg-soft); font: 400 14px/1 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'PingFang SC', sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--c-well); border-color: var(--c-ghost); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgb(var(--c-lit) / 0.72); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 36px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid rgb(var(--c-lit) / 0.35); border-radius: var(--c-radius, 2px); background: var(--c-ground); color: var(--c-lit); font: 400 14px/1 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'PingFang SC', sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: rgb(var(--c-lit) / 0.06); } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgb(var(--c-lit) / 0.72); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Title, notes, search and import fields.
components.css: .ds-field { width: 100%; min-height: 40px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--c-hairline); border-radius: var(--c-radius-sm, 2px); background: var(--c-panel); color: var(--c-fg); font: 400 16px/1.4 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'PingFang SC', sans-serif; outline: none; } .ds-field::placeholder { color: var(--c-ghost); } .ds-field:focus { border-color: var(--c-ghost); } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgb(var(--c-lit) / 0.72); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 4px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--c-hairline); border-radius: var(--c-radius-sm, 2px); background: var(--c-panel); color: var(--c-fg-soft); font: 400 12px/1.2 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'PingFang SC', sans-serif; } .ds-chip:hover { background: var(--c-well); } .ds-chip[aria-pressed='true'] { background: var(--c-fg); color: var(--c-panel); border-color: var(--c-fg); }

components.name: Work Cell
components.description: One due work in the daily board; the fixed row that never shifts.
components.css: .ds-cell { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; width: 100%; padding: 12px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--c-hairline); border-radius: var(--c-radius, 2px); background: var(--c-panel); color: var(--c-fg); text-align: left; } .ds-cell:hover { background: var(--c-well); } .ds-cell:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgb(var(--c-lit) / 0.72); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-segbar { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 3px; width: 24px; } .ds-seg { display: block; height: 4px; border-radius: 1px; background: var(--c-lit-ghost); } .ds-seg-lit { background: var(--c-lit); } .ds-seg-done { background: var(--c-done); } .ds-cell-copy { display: flex; min-width: 0; flex: 1; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; } .ds-cell-copy strong { font: 400 17px/1.1 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'PingFang SC', sans-serif; } .ds-cell-copy small { color: var(--c-dim); font: 400 11px/1.2 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'PingFang SC', sans-serif; } .ds-cell-num { color: var(--c-dim); font: 400 11px/1 'SF Mono', Consolas, monospace; }

components.name: Hold Key
components.description: The single authored entrance into recitation: press and hold to fill the key.
components.css: .ds-holdkey { position: relative; width: 100%; padding: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--c-hairline); border-radius: var(--c-radius, 2px); background: var(--c-panel); color: var(--c-fg); font: 400 15px/1.2 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'PingFang SC', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.18em; } .ds-holdkey small { margin-left: 10px; color: var(--c-dim); font: 400 9px/1 'SF Mono', Consolas, monospace; letter-spacing: 0.22em; } .ds-holdkey:hover { background: var(--c-well); } .ds-holdkey:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgb(var(--c-lit) / 0.72); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: 这是一台只服务背诵的仪表。今天到期的每一篇占一个固定格子，已背的点亮，未背的保持刻意设计过的熄灭态；顶部读数是当天进度，底部长按键是一次“拉动”，把界面从读数板切成背诵态。默认方向之外还有六套同构纸墨皮肤，只替换颜色、纸面与明暗，不改变布局、段码语义与交互。
keyCharacteristics: 以篇为单位的固定格子，而不是无限卡片流。
缺席是设计对象：未点亮的段仍有轮廓。
数字用大号等宽读数承担重量。
状态一律由段、边框与明暗表达。
原文是屏幕中心，操作层贴着底部安全区。

rules.name: The One Lit Segment Rule
rules.body: 同一时刻只让一个“当前”状态使用高亮红；已完成用绿，逾期用琥珀，三者不互相抢焦点。

rules.name: The No Badge Rule
rules.body: 进度与状态优先由段码、边框和读数表达；不要新增对勾徽章、进度环或连续天数胶囊。

rules.name: The Readout Rule
rules.body: 所有会变化的数字使用等宽与表格数字；不要用比例字体显示进度、分钟、段号或时间。

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: 内容区默认平铺；阴影只在元素离开纸面或成为临时浮层时出现。

dos: Do keep the fixed work cells in the day board after they are completed; a completed day should still show its record.
Do use red for current, green for complete, amber for overdue, and the ghost tone for absent.
Do keep the 2px surface radius and 1px segment radius in every new component.
Do keep core actions within one-hand reach at the bottom, above the nav and mini-player.
Do preserve keyboard focus, 16px mobile inputs, safe-area padding and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Don't introduce the hero-metric template, progress rings, streak badges or card stacks.
Don't use gradient text, decorative glass, hard offset shadows or colored 2px+ side borders.
Don't use emoji as the icon system; draw or reuse the linear SVG set.
Don't let a theme change the information architecture or the meaning of each segment state.
Don't shrink long Chinese text to fit; change the container or let it scroll.
